tideland.subtitle_zh: 永昌堡外 · 芦苇与潮沟
tideland.subtitle_en: Beyond Yongchang Fort · reeds and tide channels
tideland.description_zh: 开阔滩涂，敌潮从四面合围。标准移速、标准灯油消耗。
tideland.description_en: Open flats where the tide closes from every side. Standard speed and oil drain.

watergate.description_zh: 湿滑堤道拖慢脚步，敌潮更密，但灯油烧得更慢。
watergate.description_en: Slick causeways slow movement and the tide presses harder, but oil burns slower.

crossstreet.subtitle_zh: 永昌堡内 · 窄巷与铺面
crossstreet.subtitle_en: Inside Yongchang Fort · lanes and shopfronts
crossstreet.description_zh: 巷战拥挤，敌人更硬、更少，灯油消耗更快。
crossstreet.description_en: Cramped street fighting: tougher but fewer foes, with faster oil drain.
